confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Amsterdam prices, not from live listings, menus or booking pages. Restaurant, cafe and drink anchors are more reliable than July hotel and hostel rates, which vary widely in peak season. Cocktail and wine are direct estimates, not derived from beer. USD values assume roughly EUR 1 = USD 1.16.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is general knowledge of Amsterdam, benchmarked loosely against other high-cost Western European capitals with strong July tourist demand.
